# avaTOK

> avaTOK is a free India-first marketplace where anyone can earn money from home by
> selling their time and attention. You sign up free, create a free listing — listening
> to someone's stress, being a home friend, a chat, a conversation, advice, a virtual
> date, a consultation — or you live stream. People subscribe to your calendar, book a
> slot, and you get paid. No followers, no fee, no interview, no fixed shift required.

Site: https://avatok.ai
Language: English (India) · Currency: avaTOK tokens, where 1 token = ₹1, withdrawn to a bank account over UPI.

## What avaTOK is for

- **Earning from home.** The core use case: someone who wants to work or sit at home and
  make money with a phone. There is no joining fee, no equipment to buy, and you set your
  own price and your own hours.
- **Getting paid to listen.** A large share of listings are simply someone willing to
  hear another person out — work stress, family stress, loneliness, a bad day. Being a
  good listener is a sufficient qualification to start.
- **Being a "home friend".** Ongoing friendly conversation, in the buyer's own language,
  at a time they choose.
- **Booked 1:1 sessions.** Chats, discussions, advice, tuition, consultations, virtual
  dates — anything that fits in a scheduled call.
- **Live streaming.** Ticketed or subscriber live streams of anything: everyday life, a
  trek or hike, a puja, a cooking channel, music, travel, gaming.
- **Influencers and creators.** Creators with an existing audience monetise it directly
  through paid live events, paid 1:1 time and a subscribable calendar — but the
  marketplace is deliberately built so a first-time creator with zero followers can take
  a booking on day one.

## How it works (five steps)

1. **Sign up free** at https://avatok.ai/sign-up — no fee, no interview.
2. **Create a free listing** describing what you offer and what it costs.
3. **Open your calendar** with the hours you are available; people subscribe to it.
4. **Talk, or go live** — take the booked call/chat, or stream.
5. **Get paid** — earnings land in your avaTOK wallet in tokens (1 token = ₹1) and
   withdraw to your bank over UPI.

## Trust and safety

Identity is verified, payments are held in escrow until the session is delivered, and a
creator's phone number is never exposed to the people who book them. Community guidelines
and an acceptable-use policy are enforced, with a grievance channel for India.

The creator dashboard (/dashboard), AvaVision (/vision) and admin (/admin) are
authenticated product surfaces and are excluded from search and from this summary.
